title: Seoul in 3 days of eating: 13 food stops
desc: A 3-day Seoul food route covering markets, soups, bakeries, cafes and BBQ, from Jongno to Seongsu and Hongdae.

items.title: Daehwajeong Real Haejangguk (대화정 진짜해장국)
items.memo: Haejangguk (Korean hangover soup); a classic hearty breakfast.

items.title: Gwangjang Market
items.memo: Historic market famous for bindaetteok, mayak gimbap and yukhoe.

items.title: Neungdong Minari Seongsu (능동미나리 성수)
items.memo: Restaurant in Seongsu known for minari (water dropwort) dishes.

items.title: Bukchon Mugunghwa (북촌무궁화)
items.memo: Restaurant in Bukchon, handy for a meal while exploring the hanok area.

items.title: Gil Bar Dak (길바닥)
items.memo: Casual Korean restaurant; good stop for a local-style meal.

items.title: Anthracite Coffee Hapjeong
items.memo: The original Anthracite cafe in Hapjeong, in a converted factory.

items.title: Namdaemun Market
items.memo: Large traditional market with street food stalls and shopping.

items.title: Buil Galbi (부일갈비)
items.memo: Galbi (Korean BBQ ribs) restaurant; worth adding to the list.
